student.title: Student Record
student.description: Represents a student, their academic performance, attendance and results metadata.

id.description: Auto-generated Firestore ID or custom ID

seatNumber.description: Unique registration or seat number used for public search

grade.description: School Grade Level (e.g. الصف الأول، الصف الثاني)

subjectGrades.description: Grades for mapped subjects, key is subject ID, value is numeric score

totalPoints.description: Total points accumulated across all subjects

resultStatus.description: Status of the student: ناجح, راسب

reason.description: Reason for result status (e.g. failing a subject or poor attendance)

teacher.title: Teacher Profile
teacher.description: Represents a school teacher authorized to manage grades for a particular grade.

id.description: Grade ID (same as the grade identifier)

subjects.description: List of subjects and their min passing grades

complaint.title: Student Appeal
complaint.description: Represents an academic result appeal or complaint registered by a student.

studentName.description: Arabic triple name of the student

gradeId.description: Index or ID of student grade

details.description: Literal detail or context explaining the issue

contactPhone.description: Mobile or phone number for prompt follow-up

registration.title: New Student Admission Request
registration.description: Represents a prospective new student registration submitted by parents for review.

studentName.description: Full Arabic name of the candidate student

parentName.description: Full Arabic name of the parent or guardian

gradeId.description: Target Grade Id candidate wants to enroll into

nationalId.description: National ID number of candidate student

parentPhone.description: Active phone number of parent or guardian

status.description: Status of the registration request: قيد المراجعة، مقبول مبدئياً، مرفوض

notes.description: Admin notes regarding the request evaluation

customFields.description: Custom dynamic form fields added by admin and filled by user

custom_form_field.title: Custom Dynamic Form Field
custom_form_field.description: An additional input field configured by block administrators for registration or complaint forms.

section.description: The form section: registration or complaints

type.description: Field input type e.g. text, number, date, textarea, checkbox

students.description: Public and editable list of school student records.

teachers.description: Authorized teacher logins and grade permissions.

grade_settings.description: School rules, subjects, and pass rates defined for each grade level.

complaints.description: Academic appeals and student administration feedback grievances.

registrations.description: Prospecting new student registration and admission applications.

custom_form_fields.description: Configurable custom fields added dynamically by Admin for onboarding or appeal forms.

archived_students.description: School graduates and archived student records.
